noise_floor: accuracy 0.72-0.78 over 5 v1-prompt runs (±2 claims); the CONTRADICTED->SUPPORTED confusion appears intermittently under v1 too (0-1 claims/run) — earlier attribution of it to the prompt experiment was wrong
note: First verdict baseline, judge prompt v1. All 8 errors are under-commitment (S/C judged UNVERIFIABLE): 5 are embedded fabrications where the judge evaluated the reporting frame ('some analyses claim X') instead of the embedded assertion X — a convention mismatch with the golden labels, not a retrieval gap (diagnosed from rationales; evidence was present). The judge never fabricated support: no UNVERIFIABLE->S/C and no S<->C confusion. Quote checks: 0-1 downgrades per run. ADDENDUM: two measured attempts to fix the embedded-fabrication convention in the judge prompt scored 0.75 both times (within noise, no improvement) — reverted; the proper fix is likely extraction-altitude (store the embedded assertion as the claim), deferred to Phase 5.
